title: Think-Probe-Respond: Improving Large Language Models as Judges of Research Idea Novelty
abstract: arXiv:2608.25660v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Automated novelty judgment can accelerate scientific discovery by enabling efficient evaluation, refinement, and comparison of research ideas. While large language models are increasingly adopted for this task, we investigate a previously overlooked limitation in their judgment capabilities: despite generating reasoning rationales that closely mirror those of human experts, their final novelty judgments often diverge substantially. We demonstrate that this miscalibration stems from a systematic bias towards judging ideas as "medium novel". To mitigate this, we propose Think-Probe-Respond (TPR), a lightweight approach that probes latent novelty judgments from hidden states during the reasoning phase and uses the probed judgments to condition the final response. Across strong baselines, TPR improves novelty judgment performance by 22.30% and successfully mitigates the prevalent "medium novelty" bias.

translated_title: 思考-探测-回应：提升大语言模型作为研究想法新颖性评判者的能力
translated_abstract: 自动新颖性判断可以通过高效评估、改进和比较研究想法来加速科学发现。尽管大语言模型越来越多地被用于此任务，我们调查了其判断能力中一个先前被忽视的局限性：尽管生成的推理理由与人类专家的推理高度相似，但最终的新颖性判断往往存在显著分歧。我们证明这种校准偏差源于一种系统性的倾向，即倾向于将想法判断为“中等新颖”。为缓解这一问题，我们提出了思考-探测-回应（TPR）方法，这是一种轻量级方法，在推理阶段从隐藏状态中探测潜在的新颖性判断，并利用探测到的判断来调节最终响应。在强基线模型上，TPR将新颖性判断性能提升了22.30%，并成功缓解了普遍的“中等新颖”偏差。
tldr: 本文提出一种轻量级方法TPR，通过探测大语言模型隐藏状态中的潜在新颖性判断来校准最终响应，有效缓解了“中等新颖”偏差并提升了22.30%的判断性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a lightweight method TPR that probes latent novelty judgments from hidden states of large language models to calibrate final responses, mitigating the "medium novelty" bias and improving judgment performance by 22.30%.
